query: I2V fails on ROCm 7.1/Windows with shifting tensor errors (shape invalid in unpatchify, 'Boolean value of Tensor'). A peer user with a near-identical stack shows the I2V code path works fine on ROCm, pointing to a config mistake (invalid frame count), not the AMD environment.

desired.outcome: Peer user (zisisvangelis-gif) with the same PyTorch/ROCm/Wrapper stack completed >12 I2V generations and identified OP's num_frames:16 as invalid — Wan needs 4n+1 frames (17,21,...); suggested trying 17 plus a full working config (tiled_vae false, blocks_to_swap low). Not OP-confirmed; also measured blocks_to_swap 10 vs 20 = 8.7x speed difference.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
desired.answer_guidance: Peer user (zisisvangelis-gif) with the same PyTorch/ROCm/Wrapper stack completed >12 I2V generations and identified OP's num_frames:16 as invalid — Wan needs 4n+1 frames (17,21,...); suggested trying 17 plus a full working config (tiled_vae false, blocks_to_swap low). desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Resist blaming the ROCm stack and instead spot that num_frames:16 violates Wan's 4n+1 frame requirement (use 17+), per a peer's identical-stack evidence.
